title: Fire of Asshurbanipal

[[Image:FireOfAsshurbanipal.png|right|160px]]
'''Fire of Asshurbanipal''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Bonus''': While any [[investigator]] has Fire of Asshurbanipal in his possession, the maximum number of [[gate]]s that may be open at once before the [[Ancient One]] awakens is increased by 1.

'''Price''': $6

==Mythos Source==
The Fire of Asshurbanipal first appeared in ''The Fire of Asshurbanipal'' (1936), written by Robert E. Howard.
